recipe.text: Tudor cottage from primitives at (-150,0,-150): 26x18 footprint, 10-stud walls + 7-stud roof rise. Walls built as segments around openings (door 4w x 7h front-center; 3-4 stud windows on every face). Timber look = 0.5-0.7 stud Wood beams protruding 0.35 from plaster SmoothPlastic walls (top plate/mid rail/sill + posts + 40-deg braces). Roof = two Slate slabs rotated atan(7/10) with 1.5-stud overhang + WedgePart gables (yaw 0/180 only - +90 yaw makes them read as fins). Brick chimney outside the right gable breaks the silhouette. Capture verified from back/right/iso; foreign red/pink parts on horizon are outside the container.
